benefits.name: United Club Membership
benefits.description: Unlimited United Club access for the cardholder and one guest.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardholder plus one guest. All Access membership — which admits two adult guests, or one adult guest plus dependent children, and adds Star Alliance lounge access — unlocks at Premier Gold status or $50,000 in annual spend.

benefits.name: Two Free Checked Bags
benefits.description: First and second standard checked bags free for the primary Cardmember and one traveling companion on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Applies to United- and United Express-operated flights.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels and Resorts Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 annually in statement credits on prepaid bookings with Renowned Hotels and Resorts.

benefits.name: Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Up to $150 annually in statement credits on eligible rideshare purchases.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Issued as $12 per month January through November and $18 in December.

benefits.name: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: Up to $240 annually in Instacart statement credits, issued as $10 per month.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Benefit ends 12/31/27 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Avis and Budget Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 annually in United TravelBank cash on Avis or Budget rentals.
benefits.terms: Issued as United TravelBank cash rather than a statement credit.

benefits.name: JSX Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 annually in statement credits on JSX flight purchases.

benefits.name: United FareLock Credit
benefits.description: Up to $50 annually in statement credits on United FareLock purchases.
benefits.terms: FareLock must be purchased with the card on a United- or United Express-operated flight.

benefits.name: Global Economy Plus Seat Upgrades
benefits.description: Two global Economy Plus seat upgrades after spending $40,000 on purchases each year.

benefits.name: Better Together Anniversary Bonus
benefits.description: 5,000 bonus miles each year when you also hold a personal United credit card.
benefits.terms: Requires holding both this card and a personal United credit card.

benefits.name: Premier Qualifying Points from Spend
benefits.description: Earn 1 PQP per $15 in net purchases, up to 28,000 PQP per calendar year, toward Premier status.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars, up to $60,000.
benefits.terms: Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per covered traveler and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $500 per item, $1,000 per 12 months, when a merchant will not accept a return.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year, up to 4 years total.

earningRates.terms: Hotel stays booked through Renowned Hotels and Resorts.
2x miles from the card on eligible United purchases. United flights earn 8x total when combined with the 6x earned as a MileagePlus member.
